name: 75601 · Longview, TX
findings: ZIP 75601 (Longview) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75601 (Longview) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75601 (Longview) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.
